title: Circuit Complexity in Lean 4
abstract: A Lean 4 formalization of classical Boolean circuit complexity, including the Shannon counting lower bound, Schnorr's XOR gate lower bound, a gate-elimination lower bound, CNF/DNF lower bounds for parity, and nondeterministic quantification complexity bounds.

informal.CircuitComplexity.shannon_lower_bound_ci: For N at least 6, there exists a Boolean function on N inputs that cannot be computed by any fan-in-2 AND/OR circuit of size at most 2^N / (5N).
informal.CircuitComplexity.schnorr_lower_bound_ci: Any fan-in-2 AND/OR circuit computing the N-input XOR function (or its complement) has at least 2(N-1) internal gates.
informal.CircuitComplexity.Circuit.gate_eliminati: Any circuit over bounded fan-in k AND/OR computing a function with n' essential inputs has size at least n' / k.
informal.CircuitComplexity.DNF.xorBool_complexity: Any DNF formula computing the N-input XOR function requires at least 2^(N-1) terms.
informal.CircuitComplexity.CNF.xorBool_complexity: Any CNF formula computing the N-input XOR function requires at least 2^(N-1) clauses.
informal.CircuitComplexity.existQuantify_complexi: If a function f has circuit complexity s, then the existential quantification of f over a k-bit block has circuit complexity at most 2^k * (s + 1).
